## Objectives

1. Look at the old gate wall in [The War Camp Ruins](../maps/war_camp_ruins.md)
2. Look at the broken tower wall in [The War Camp Ruins](../maps/war_camp_ruins.md)
3. Look at the high wall in [The War Camp Ruins](../maps/war_camp_ruins.md)
4. Defeat 100 War Mask or Bone Hounds ([War Mask](../monsters/war_mask.md), [Bone Hound](../monsters/bone_hound.md))
